transcript.text: Here are the arbitration findings from my reconciliation. While going through the late-produced onboarding export and cross-referencing it against the user-agreement database, I confirmed that exactly 312 of the 480 putative class members have executed agreements containing an arbitration provision. The remaining 168 putative class members do not have arbitration agreements on file. This is a material discrepancy from any assumption that all 480 class members are subject to arbitration. I have not yet incorporated this reconciliation into the formal arbitration analysis, but the group should be aware that we can only compel arbitration for roughly 65% of the putative class under current agreements. This significantly affects our arbitration posture and should factor into Marisol's response strategy.
